title: pilosella lactucella subsp. lampreilema
intro: Pilosella lactucella subsp. lampreilema, commonly known as Hawkweed, is a type of flowering plant in the sunflower family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used to treat various health issues, including inflammation and digestive problems, due to its health benefits of aiding in wound healing and reducing fever. The therapeutic actions of Pilosella lactucella subsp. lampreilema include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its use in treating skin irritations and infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, sesquiterpene lactones, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
